title: Nine activity and extraction tests do not detect the fixed 13.505-day wave in selected HD 1461 data
abstract: We test eight HARPS diagnostics and the independent HIRES calcium S index at the known HD 1461 velocity period of 13.50512710 days. No diagnostic passes a block-sign test after correction for nine tests. This holds for 10-, 30- and 90-day blocks and two slow baseline models. There are 244 to 245 HARPS nights and 214 HIRES nights. The velocity control passes, with a raw tail of 0.00025. In the main 30-day simulation, recovery is 89.6 to 100 percent for diagnostic waves at half the residual RMS, but 19.7 to 53.6 percent at one quarter RMS. The SERVAL minus DRS wave amplitude is 0.0337 m/s. These null results limit large coherent diagnostic waves under the tested error models. They do not exclude a stellar source for the known velocity signal, prove a planet, or detect a new object. The package contains code, aggregate results, a figure, source hashes and external retrieval steps. Source records are excluded.
